'''Ralan''' was a [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was inside [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]]'s laboratory together with [[Eckard Lokin]] when it was attacked by [[rakghoul]]s. In the ensuing fight, Ralan lasted longer than his fellow soldiers and managed to finish off the remaining rakghouls before succumbing to his wounds. He did not transform into a rakghoul himself, so his wounds must have come from weapons, not rakghoul bites.
